name: f489b6c25bf0
claim: When the PEER_CA_SHA256 pin does not match the peer presented certificate, peer_tls.py strips the bearer token and fails the connection closed rather than forwarding an unauthenticated request.

decisions.notes: A pin mismatch caused the launcher to fall back to plain HTTP and strip the bearer token; the Mac flush reported invalid PEER_CA_SHA256 and the token was refused.

rationale: Fail closed on trust mismatch; never downgrade to unauthenticated HTTP for peer bearer tokens.
